description: Maker HTTP API (protocol v1) recorded from the TypeScript maker (makerHandler over a Maker with in-memory chains, deterministic randomness, Date.now() = 1800000000000). Bodies are JSON; the canonical text of a body is its compact JSON.stringify serialization in the key order shown. bigint fields are decimal strings. Only `code` is normative in error bodies; `error` texts are informative.

environment.randomness: getRandomValues replaced by the SHA-256 stream seeded "paralock/vectors/v1/maker-harness"
